title: Soil pH and Electrical Conductivity Interpolation — San José Field, Jalisco, México
description: Reproducible dataset for IDW spatial interpolation of soil pH and electrical conductivity (CE) from 21 georeferenced sampling points. Includes field boundary, raw data, interpolation configuration, and IDW results validated against the AgRegen 5.0 geo-service.

pH.interpretation: All samples are strongly to very strongly acidic (pH < 5.5). Liming required.

CE_dSm.interpretation: Mean CE is non-saline. Outlier at point 13 (CE = 0.87 dS/m) warrants investigation.

interpolation.algorithm_reference: Shepard (1968) — A two-dimensional interpolation function for irregularly-spaced data

zones.recommendation: Apply agricultural lime (CaCO₃) at rates proportional to acidity deficit

platform.name: AgRegen 5.0
platform.module: Variable Rate Management (MVZ) — Soil Sampling + Interpolation
